description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into ClickUp tasks in a target List. Rows are matched to existing tasks by a key marker embedded in the task description (e.g. <!-- dagster-key: INC-1001 -->); ClickUp has no native upsert endpoint for tasks.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one ClickUp task (upserted via key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in ClickUp.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

list_id.label: List Id
list_id.description: Target ClickUp List ID tasks are created/matched in.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique key, embedded as a dagster-key marker in the task description.

description_column.label: Description Column
description_column.description: Column holding the task description (plain text/markdown).

status_column.label: Status Column
status_column.description: Column holding a ClickUp status name configured on the target List.

assignees_column.label: Assignees Column
assignees_column.description: Column holding ClickUp user IDs to assign. Accepts a list, or a comma-separated string of ints.

tags_column.label: Tags Column
tags_column.description: Column holding tag names. Accepts a list, or a comma-separated string.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

name: ClickUp Task Upsert
